description: Answers upset questions from the men's tournament counted game by game, 1985-2026 (41 tournaments, 2,583 games): how often a seed line wins its first-round game (stated as wins in 164 games), how many first-round upsets a typical year has, and how far a seed has gone. Ask with a matchup ('12 vs 5'), a seed, or no argument for the whole table. These are counted historical facts, not odds, not win probabilities for any future game, and not betting advice. The dataset is men's only and covers the main bracket from the round of 64 (no First Four games).

matchup.description: A first-round seed pairing, e.g. '12 vs 5'. Optional.

seed.description: One seed, 1 to 16: returns its first-round seed line. Optional.

name: get_upset_counts
title: Get counted upset history
